'''Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds''' is the sixth of the [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|numbered Virtual Sets]] the [[Players Committee]] released between 2002 and 2009. Each of its 50 cards is a printed slip that replaces the bottom half of a [[Decipher]] card. The slip gives new game text, stats and icons; the title, lore and art stay as printed. The Committee released it on 21 November 2003; the final revised text became tournament-legal on 12 January 2004.<ref name="legal" /> In December 2006 the Committee reissued it as a ''Remaster'' sheet with new pack art, a set symbol and the final text.<ref name="ia" />

The Remaster column sets each slip onto its printed Decipher card, re-typeset at 600 DPI in the style of the Committee's later Holotable cards. They were made for the wiki in 2026 and are fan reconstructions, not Committee products (see [[Typography of Star Wars CCG cards]]). Game text is written out in full where the slips use the icon shorthand explained at [[Virtual card icons]].

== Original slips ==
The set was first released on 21 November 2003 on the Committee's old pre-template slips, not in the Remaster template shown in the table above; revised texts followed on 31 December 2003 and a “Final Revised Virtual Set 6” sheet on 12 January 2004.<ref name="legal" /> The first release sheet of 21 November 2003 is not preserved. {{Mystery|question=Does a copy of the first release sheet of 21 November 2003 survive|section=Lost original slip sheets}} The 31 December 2003 texts survive only as a one-page rules supplement, “Changes to Virtual Set #6” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20040615005231/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/v6changes.pdf v6changes.pdf], Internet Archive capture 15 June 2004), which gives interim texts for ten cards and says they “are not final”. Four of those texts differ from the 12 January 2004 sheet, so each is now its card's earliest version (base page), with the January and October 2004 slips and the Remaster following as (Errata) to (Errata 3): [[Lobot (V) (Virtual Set 6)|Lobot (V)]], [[Rebel Planners (V) (Virtual Set 6)|Rebel Planners (V)]], [[Redemption (V) (Virtual Set 6)|Redemption (V)]] and [[The Emperor (V) (Virtual Set 6)|The Emperor (V)]]. Five give the same words as the 12 January 2004 sheet but print the immunity as “(Immune to Alter)” in words instead of the icon (Despair (V) also lacks a full stop before it, Seeking An Audience (V) types the arrow as “\/”); a visibly different text in a separate publication is a version, so these are base pages too: [[Civil Disorder (V) (Virtual Set 6)|Civil Disorder (V)]], [[Down With The Emperor! (V) (Virtual Set 6)|Down With The Emperor! (V)]], [[Seeking An Audience (V) (Virtual Set 6)|Seeking An Audience (V)]], [[A Day Long Remembered (V) (Virtual Set 6)|A Day Long Remembered (V)]] and [[Despair (V) (Virtual Set 6)|Despair (V)]], with the January 2004 slip as (Errata) and the Remaster as (Errata 2). For [[Boba Fett (V) (Virtual Set 6)|Boba Fett (V)]] the supplement says only “This virtual card must be used with the Cloud City set persona.” (no game text); that entry is its base page in the same way. [[Jabba's Influence (V) (Virtual Set 6) (Errata)|Jabba's Influence (V)]] also has a text-only errata posted in the Committee's forum on 9 November 2005 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20060617231905/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=4438 “Current Rulings/Errata”], Internet Archive capture 17 June 2006), between the 2004 slip and the Remaster. Two sheets of old slips survive:
* the final revised sheet of 12 January 2004 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20040619231451/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf] on swccgpc.com, Internet Archive capture 19 June 2004; PDF dated 12 January 2004), which the Committee still hosts, as the same file, as [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards6.pdf VirtualCards6.pdf] on res.starwarsccg.org (linked from its [https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Virtual slips] page);
* the revised sheet of 12 October 2004 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20050406053829/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/Virtual%20Set%206.pdf Virtual Set 6.pdf] on swccgpc.com, Internet Archive capture 6 April 2005; PDF dated 12 October 2004), listed on the Committee's Virtual Cards page as “Revised 10/12/2004”.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20060206230426/http://www.swccgpc.com/virtualcards.htm Virtual Cards], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 6 February 2006.</ref>
Each old slip is a version of its card. The base page of each Virtual Original card, “… (V) (Virtual Set 6)”, is its earliest surviving text: the 12 January 2004 slip, or for ten cards the 31 December 2003 interim text (see above). The 12 October 2004 sheet changed six slips (Computer Interface (V), Lobot (V), Rebel Planners (V), Redemption (V), The Emperor (V), We're The Bait (V); their slip marks gained an “a”, except We're The Bait (V), whose only change is its quotation marks); those texts are “(Errata)” pages. On the other 44 slips the second sheet is the same, pixel for pixel, so it is shown as a second image of the base page. The Remaster text shown in the table above is the latest version of each card (“(Errata)” to “(Errata 3)”). Every page gives the full text of each version with its source.

== Printings ==
The Committee re-edited the Remaster sheet on 14 September 2007 with errata to [[Despair (V) (Virtual Set 6) (Errata 2)|Despair (V)]] (#32).<ref name="ia" /> In the [[2009 Virtual Block Reorganization|2009 reorganisation]] the Committee regrouped these cards into the [[:Category:Virtual Legacy sets|Virtual Blocks]].<ref name="reorg2009">[https://web.archive.org/web/20090918131415/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org] (Internet Archive, 18 September 2009): the Players Committee realigned Virtual Sets 1–18 into thematic Virtual Blocks.</ref> Some returned in the [[:Category:Current Virtual sets|Virtual Sets]] released after the 2014 Reset with the same or revised game text.
